headline: Contested Fronts Stir Across the War Map
war_summary: The latest returns show the main fighting concentrated in a handful of unsettled sectors, with Weathered Expanse again the chief furnace. It logged 13 base events in the last two hours and 58 across the day, while its ledger remains divided among four Warden, two Colonial, and three neutral holdings; casualty activity is cooling over one hour but accelerating across two. Palantine Berm has also quickened, posting 10 events in two hours and 30 in 24, with both casualty streams and enlistments rising. Stlican Shelf has reopened after its earlier lull, registering five recent events and 27 for the day, though its casualty pace is now cooling. Callahan’s Passage remains a major but less immediate battleground: six events arrived in six hours and 35 in the day, with eight Warden and two Colonial bases. Nevish Line has likewise quieted in the latest two-hour window, yet its divided seven-to-one ownership and 20 daily events keep it in the field report. Stonecradle is active on the longer ledger, with 12 daily events and five in six hours.
